CustomField.description: The record ID of the Campaign this appeal is copied to by Campaign sync (Connect). Text, not a lookup, so Connect installs where Campaign does not exist (ADR-0013).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Campaign this appeal is copied to. Filled in by Campaign sync. Paste an existing Campaign's record ID to link to it, or clear it to have a new Campaign made.
CustomField.label: Campaign ID
